risk_description: Red Sea and Middle East shipping disruption raising transit times and freight cost
adjustment_action: Nearshoring about 25% of volume to Morocco, Portugal and Turkey by 2028 and holding extra safety stock

risk_description: Water scarcity and heat in cotton-growing regions driving cotton cost and quality volatility
adjustment_action: Shifting to recycled and certified cotton; 100% recycled or sustainably sourced materials by 2030

risk_description: EU CSDDD due diligence and forced-labour import rules
adjustment_action: Full supplier traceability programme and third-party audits of tier-1 and tier-2 factories
Investing in lab-grown leather R&D and securing long-term hide contracts

risk_description: Extreme heat and flooding disrupting Bangladesh and Pakistan factory output
adjustment_action: Dual-sourcing every core category and funding factory heat-resilience upgrades

risk_description: Tariff changes on Asian-sourced apparel across the US, UK and EU
adjustment_action: Re-pricing and moving 15% of volume from China to Vietnam and Turkey

risk_description: UK and EU extended producer responsibility rules for textiles
adjustment_action: Launching a take-back and recycled-fibre programme

risk_description: EU digital product passport and ecodesign rules for apparel
adjustment_action: Building product-level material and origin data into its PLM

risk_description: Port congestion and volatile container rates
adjustment_action: Booking more fixed-rate capacity and shifting some flows to rail
